_comment: Scenario 1 (Denied Access — user not in group) demo data AND UC21 tier data. restrictedTools maps tools to the group required (binary gate, UC9). userGroups maps demo users to their group memberships — includes both PrivilegedBanking (UC9 binary deny) and PrivateBanking (UC21 tier). demoDelegate has no groups → resolves to Standard tier (wire tools denied, $2k ceiling). Enforcement gated by ff_authorize_group_policy (default OFF). Mirror any change to live PingOne Authorize (directory group membership) and demo_authz_server.
